notes.title: Welcome back to Murray's playhouse!
notes.content:
In the most recent update we have focused a lot more on bug fixes, as well as adding a new puzzle room, a new trap and a few more decorations to add to the creep factor in the playhouse. 
We have also added an info book, a quick guide to surviving the playhouse including the new added “Wobble Blocks room”.

Patch Notes:

New additions:

The Wobble Blocks Room, designed by Murray to get you looking around the room including cabinets and safes. This room is designed to keep you walking backwards and forwards to check your answers while Murray chases you down.
Info Book, designed as a quick guide in regards to puzzle rooms. Can be accessed during the game and on the main menu. 
Bear Trap, added for the player to be more aware of their surroundings, as stepping in a trap may impede the player's movement for a time.
More decorations, some more visual effects and props so keep an eye out.
New sound effects, both in game and on the main menu screen.
The teddies and dead now occasionally watch you...

Fixes:

Several bugs in regards to lights and power switches.
Emission turned down on several lights.
Fixes journal pages appearing after collecting all pages.
Fixed cursor issue with Journal.
Various other bug fixes.

Future Plans:
Education version, designed to be a little more forgiving and more designed around learning Math.
Language Localisation, to allow everyone anywhere to play without being stopped via language barrier.
Colour-blind mode, to help with visuals as the in game lighting can be very harsh for some players.

As well as this update we are also working on several other projects such as our new larger scale co-op game due to release early next year.

We want to thank everyone who has supported Wobble Blocks thus far and has given feedback to help with MATH IS HORROR. Your feedback and support has allowed us to continue game development and branch into newer games!
We hope to see some high scores in the near future!

Love, the Wobble Blocks Team.

notes.title: Update 1.2 is Here!
notes.content:
A new update has arrived to Math is Horror!
With new room generation, balancing, and additional puzzles. The game now offers more diverse gameplay and choices. When given the opportunity, you will be able to choose which path you take and which puzzles you solve.
Patch Notes:
- Balanced the 'Puppies and Kittens' Puzzles to be less punishing.
- Added a new puzzle. Count the correct lights and solve the equation.
- Changed room generation to allow for multiple paths.
- Ricky escaped.
- Added story note pick-ups. You can find the Journal entries on the main menu. These may provide some info on where you are.
- Added more decorations, as well as openable containers (for an upcoming update)
